caret.description: where the caret stands, as an offset into text

filter.description: a query being typed, in a page's own graph: the text and the caret, kept across a reload of the tab; what can come next there is its completion

from.description: where the word being completed starts

to.description: where the word being completed ends

cands.description: what can replace that word, each its text as it reads once taken and the kind of thing it is (@yaks/query complete)

pick.description: which of cands is picked, -1 for none: what is typed already reads whole

completion.description: what can come next where a query is being typed (its filter): the word at the caret and what can replace it, open while cands has any; gone with the page, so a reload brings back the text and not the list
